sections.movieDesc: Endpoints used to manage and fetch Movie data.
sections.serialDesc: Endpoints used to manage and fetch Serial / Drama data.
sections.liveTvDesc: Endpoints used to manage and fetch Live TV / IPTV data.

docs.auth: All API requests need to use the Authorization header with the Bearer YOUR_API_KEY format.
docs.response: All endpoints return JSON with status, message, and data format. Errors are returned in the error property format.
docs.movieTrending: Get a list of trending movies.
docs.movieDetail: Get details of a movie along with cast and metadata.
docs.movieStream: Get a list of streaming server URLs for the movie.
docs.serialTrending: Get a list of trending serials/dramas.
docs.serialStream: Get a list of streaming server URLs for a specific episode.
docs.liveTvCountry: Get a list of all available countries for Live TV.
docs.liveTvCategory: Get a list of all available categories for Live TV.
docs.liveTvSearch: Search Live TV streams by name.
docs.liveTvList: Get a list of Live TV streams. Can be filtered by country and category slugs.
docs.liveTvStream: Get a list of streaming server URLs for a specific Live TV stream.
